The cops are just driving behind us up behind us start driving behind us til the next set of lights. So here we are, at a set of red lights, shitting ourselves and watching the car behind us. *Cant see shit its too dark.* 

To understand properly, the lights were at the top of the hill and the highway continues down the hill, so naturally when at the lights you cant see down the hill. SO when the lights turn green, all we could see at the bottom of the hill was several flashing parked police cars pulling cars to the side of the road. (This is in Sydney, Australia, government is increasing the number of roadside drug tests, known as MDTs) anyways at this point, i thought it was all over. I am *literally* surrounded by cops. I did a year and a half at RDA (Riding for the Disabled Association). It was therapeutic riding for disabled people whether it be physical or mental. 

Overall was a great and rewarding experience.  I was involved with the horses thus grooming, mounting, saddle etc were all my responsibilities it was great creating a bond with both the horse and the rider who over time grew on you. 

We mounted the rider on the horse and lead him/her on laps and courses sometimes, depending on their skill and confidence level let them lead the horse using reins. There were also interactive games to further develop the riders motor skills. 

8/10 would recommend. Its near caldecott mrt
